How to Play

Lead Lyra, a runaway apprentice, and the friends she gathers through four chapters of story, exploration and turn-based battle.

Exploring

Arrow keys / WASD walk. Space / Enter talks to the person or opens the chest in front of you; walking into them works too. On a phone, use the pad, or tap where you want to go. M opens the menu, H (or the ? button) says where to go next.

Story

Click, tap or press Space to go on; number keys pick a choice. L shows the history, Q toggles auto, E skips ahead. Every line is voiced.

Battles

Everyone acts in order of speed, shown at the top. Pick an action, then a target (tap the foe or the ally). Skills cost MP. Defend halves damage and restores a little MP. Watch for status effects: Poison, Stun, Slow, Weak, Marked, Guard, Evade, ATK Up and Taunt all do what they say. Bosses cannot be fled.

If the party falls, you can retry the battle at once, or wake at the inn for half your gold.

Growing stronger

The party shares one level. Buy weapons and armour from Marta's forge and equip them in the menu; sell what you loot. Rest at the Ember Hearth Inn to recover and save. The game also saves itself whenever you change place.

Echoes of Aethermoor

Written, designed and built in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Art painted with fal (nano-banana-2). Music, voices and sound by ElevenLabs.
